info.description: The consent banner: whether it shows, what it says, and what the site stores

options.heading: What this screen controls
options.body:
The consent banner visitors see before anything non-essential is stored. Everything on this page takes effect without a deploy, including switching the banner off entirely.

Two fields are deliberately not translated and exist only once, on the German entry — switching language will show them empty here, which is expected:

- enabled — the banner is on or off for every language at once
- cookies — the mapping of what the site stores; the same list whatever language it is read in

The mapping is maintained by hand. It is not discovered automatically: a script can only read cookies that already exist, and the whole point is not to set them before someone agrees. Adding storage to the app means adding it here and to the registry in web/src/lib/consent.ts, which is what actually refuses to write an unclassified key.

"Unclassified" should always stay empty. An entry there means something is stored that nobody has categorised.
